name: Ares
source:
A swordsman of such skill that his name spreads far beyond his own hamlet.

He harbors serious doubts that the "Will of God" is not what makes people suffer. To discover the truth for himself, he sets out on a journey alone.

A man of strong moral fiber and unflagging courage, he soon gains a group of steadfast companions.

[Taken from Hirameki International]
